current_answer: Stripe Atlas’s USD 2,500 credit is a one-year offset against eligible Stripe product fees for companies incorporated through Atlas on or after 16 October 2025. It does not pay the USD 500 Atlas setup fee or later registered-agent renewal. A founder should choose the Delaware incorporation route on its own merits, then judge whether eligible Stripe fees during the first year can use the credit; it is not cash or a free formation grant.

catalogue_card.question: Can Stripe Atlas’s USD 2,500 credit pay the USD 500 incorporation fee?
catalogue_card.text: No. The credit offsets eligible Stripe product fees after Atlas incorporation, not the USD 500 setup fee or later registered-agent renewal. It expires after one year or when used; check entity and Stripe-account fit before paying.

summary: Stripe Atlas offers USD 2,500 in fee credits to companies incorporated through Atlas on or after 16 October 2025.
Credits activate automatically on incorporation and expire after 365 days or when used. They are account-bound and not cash.
Atlas setup costs USD 500, with USD 100 annual registered-agent renewal after the first year; fee credits cannot pay those charges.
Eligible fee uses include Payments, Connect, Billing, Tax, and Sigma; the issuer lists further exclusions.
